response.evidence: Additionally, you can run the tests against a specific browser using the --environment or -e CLI argument. If you don’t have the relevant browser installed, Nightwatch will attempt to set it up for you using Selenium Manager: npx nightwatch test/index.ts -e firefox
response.rationale: In the 'Running your NightwatchJS tests' steps, the commands appear in sequence: (1) 'npx nightwatch test/index.js' to run all tests, (2) 'npx nightwatch test/index.ts -e firefox', and (3) 'npx nightwatch test/index.ts --open'. The second command uses the -e (environment) flag, and the artifact explicitly states this runs the tests against one specific browser (firefox). Installing a missing browser is only a possible side effect via Selenium Manager, and opening the HTML report is the third command, not the second.
